en: A monochrome, old-style printed postcard showing a central European town square. The scene is a drawing rather than a photograph, with baroque‑style buildings surrounding an open cobbled plaza. In the middle stands a small fenced monument or column. To the right is a church with a distinctive large onion dome topped by a star and cross, and an attached porch with arches. Behind it rises a square bell tower with a hipped roof. On the left is a long multi‑windowed building with a small turret and cross, possibly a monastery or civic building, and a vaulted gateway leading out of the square. Low wooded hills form the background. Very small text is printed at the bottom edge of the image, partly readable as dates and words but not entirely clear.
